text:
A friend recommended this clinic, and I wasn't disappointed at all!
The doctor is incredibly skilled, a first-class honors graduate from Mahidol University. She's kind, has a gentle touch, and explains everything in detail. The prices are reasonable, and parking is convenient at the gas station before the clinic. I highly recommend it! My whole family now goes to this clinic regularly.

text:
The doctor is good-natured, smiles often, and is kind. The fees are affordable, and he doesn't pressure patients into buying anything, allowing them to choose what suits their needs.

I've been receiving dental and oral care from this doctor for almost 20 years, since he was a professor at Ramathibodi Hospital. Now I've brought my mother, relatives, siblings, and friends to see him for treatment as well.

text: This is a dental clinic where I always feel comfortable every time I visit. The dentist is incredibly kind, patient, and always smiling. They answer every question in detail, clearly, and in an easy-to-understand way. They are gentle. I've been entrusting my dental care to this dentist for many years, having had extractions, orthodontics, and implants done here. Everything has gone well with my treatment. I highly recommend them!

I highly recommend this clinic!
